audit.why: 7.5/10 TRICKY at a 51.16% win rate is right, and the shipped chart is coherent: Pantheon owns 2-3 and the item stages on paper, you get the even windows at 4-6. Full and content layers already agree row for row. The mirror audit recorded no point-2 correction, so the two directions do not conflict and no flip is proposed.

The spike order is right and the level-6 entry is unusually honest — Grand Starfall is a 180/165/150s global roam tool at 5500 range, not a duel button, and the page already says so. Your All Out is back roughly twice as often as his ultimate, which is the number behind that judgement.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page invents an ability Pantheon does not have and omits the one that actually decides your commit. It says twice that 'his passive blocks your autos' — Mortal Will is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered', with no blocking whatsoever. The blocking ability is Aegis Assault (E): 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front', a 22/21/20/19/18s channel at 400 range — and it is never mentioned anywhere on the page. Also 'Q3 knock-up' three times (Ntofo Strikes pulls at two stacks, Path Maker is the knock-back and stun), 'charge W to be unstoppable' (Riot's text says only 'taking reduced damage'), and dontsFull[1] warns about a 'W execute' — Shield Vault is a dash and stun, and Pantheon has no execute in his kit.
audit.why: A player who believes his passive blocks autos will hold trades for the wrong reason and then dump a full commit into Aegis Assault, which is exactly the ability that eats it. The mirror already restated Path Maker as 'a charge-and-stun engage on 14s that cancels your channel' — the same fact from this side is the highest-value line on the page and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault (E) is a 22s channel that makes him invulnerable from the front and absorbs your burst — wait it out, or cancel it: any hard CC ends a channel, and Path Maker's stun does it outright. Mortal Will empowers his next spell. Shield Vault (W) is a 13/12/11/10/9s point-click dash and stun that also resets his attack, so the wind-up is the tell. Ntofo Strikes slows and pulls at two stacks; Path Maker's charge reduces damage taken.

audit.whatIsWrong: The most punishable cooldown on the page is Shield Vault (13s at rank 1), but the longest and most exploitable one is Aegis Assault at 22s — and it was never named.
audit.why: Forcing out a 22-second channel and then committing is a far bigger window than trading around a 13-second dash.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[1] and dosFull[2].d: don't spend burst into the shield, cancel it or wait the 22s out.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 belong to Pantheon — his W is a point-click stun he can't miss, and he chains it into an empowered Q spear while his passive blocks your return autos. You have only Q at level 1 and no engage, so don't contest the wave aggressively; soak XP at melee range and accept the chip. The moment you hit level 3 and have your full Q-W combo, you can answer: charge W to be unstoppable through his stun, smash him into a wall, and Q3 to knock him up. Bait the W-stun before you commit.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 belong to Pantheon — Shield Vault is a point-click stun he can't miss on a 13s cooldown, and he chains it into an empowered Comet Spear. You have only Q at level 1 and no engage, so don't contest the wave aggressively; soak XP at melee range and accept the chip. From level 3 your full kit answers: Path Maker's charge cuts the damage, the release stuns him into a wall, and your second Q stack pulls him back. Bait Shield Vault before you commit.

notes: The packet defect 'never names any of Pantheon's abilities' is half stale — Shield Vault and Comet Spear were named, but Aegis Assault genuinely appeared nowhere despite being the ability that decides every commit in this lane, and Mortal Will was described as an auto-block that does not exist. Both are now on the page. One claim I did NOT write: whether Aegis Assault's frontal invulnerability stops K'Sante's Path Maker knock-back from displacing him. The kit file cannot answer it and the derived 'untargetable' flag is not supported by Riot's wording ('invulnerable to damage from the front' is damage blocking, not untargetability).
